title: schizocalyx peruvianus
intro: Schizocalyx peruvianus, commonly known as Peruvian rose, is a flowering plant native to the Andean region. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and providing antioxidant benefits. The therapeutic actions of Schizocalyx peruvianus include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardiovascular protector. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
